name: Milestone by Ouroboros Apps
description: Milestone by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com). Freelance project milestones: approved milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria; a milestone is only done when the saved criteria are met. Tools: list_milestone_sets, open_milestone_set, read_milestone_set, define_milestone, save_acceptance_criterion, save_deliverable, save_work_item, record_criterion_met, declare_milestone_complete, declare_next_payment_released, mark_work_done, write_client_wording, approve_milestones, suggest_milestone_change, accept_milestone_change. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/milestone. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/milestone.
author: Ouroboros Apps
